pages.text: Create Big Cannons melts and casts its guns from the plant's metals: The Factory's cast iron and steel, and our bronze, seven copper to one tin, near the gun bronze of the old cannon founders. Its own alloying is gone: iron and coal do not stir into steel or press into cast iron, and brass and cinder flour are not bronze.
pages.title: Metal

pages.text: Nethersteel takes a netherite ingot: 4 steel with one, superheated, give 5.

A powder charge is still a bag of black powder, as at Trafalgar. Cartridges and autocannon and machine gun rounds take smokeless powder, which counts as its nitropowder; nitrocellulose is its guncotton and packs into high explosive filling, and slime no longer gelatinises anything.
pages.title: Propellant and fuzes

pages.text: Every fuze is fired by a primer: the impact fuze's firing pin strikes one, and the timed, proximity and wired fuzes fire one by clockwork, radio or current.
